The 2026 Vanmag Wish Book: 72 Holiday Gift Ideas From Vancouver Shops and Brands

From stocking stuffers to design-worthy splurges, our editors share their favourite finds from Vancouver stores, brands and makers.

By Stacey McLachlan / November 5, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
0:00 / 0:00 Instaread
Sponsored by

We’ve shopped the city to find special things for everyone on your list from our favourite shops, brands and makers. Herein, 70-plus picks from our discerning editors, alongside excellent, highly giftable suggestions from cool creatives with great taste. Consider this comprehensive guide our gift to you.

Fashion, Jewellery and Accessories

GOLD STAR

Vancouver jewellery brand Leah Yard crafts these Zodiac pendants ($195 each) in 14-karat gold fill. leahyarddesigns.com

SHOE, FLY

Nike’s well-cushioned Vomero Plus kicks ($235) come in a Dalmatian print that might motivate a personal best. runasyouare.com

IN THE BAG

Light and puffy, the Ölend Ona bag ($175) holds laptops up to 17 inches and is sold in many colours, including this silver version. nooroongji.ca

BLACK OUT

Free Label’s Rooney barrel-fit organic cotton trousers ($228) make a strong case for adding one more black pair to the closet. freelabel.com

GO ON

With adjustable compartments and an insulated snack pocket, No Reception Club’s Hideaway carry-on duffel ($345) suits travelling parents and any traveller who packs snacks. noreceptionclub.com

SEEING RED

This chunky wool-and-cotton North Beach cardigan ($189) comes in a bright red that flatters just about anyone. nettlestale.com

EDGE CASE

Pearls on one strand and rivets on another give the Barebone Anarchy necklace ($275) a punk edge. bareboneapparel.com

DESIGNER DEAL

Resale shop Mine and Yours sells pre-owned designer pieces such as this Saint Laurent AirPod case ($95), priced 75 percent below its original retail cost. mineandyours.com

IN THE BAG

Even someone with a closet full of totes should be pleased by this sleek stripey bag (from $110) by Saint-Rue Twenty Two. gatley.ca

COZY SZN

Founder Shelby Wick says the relaxed Slate Wearables Orana sweater ($348), knit entirely from Tanguis cotton, is a popular holiday pick. slatewearables.com

PLAIN JANE

Made in Portugal from 100-percent cotton, Decade Studio’s Classic T-shirt ($59) has a relaxed drape and a well-judged neckline that works casual or dressy. decadestudio.com

TIE ONE ON

A Bronze Age’s Tabi belt ($72) can be worn at the waist or knotted around the neck. abronzeage.com

BEJEWELLED

Vancouver jeweller Sarah Mulder pairs black cubic zirconia with pearls in her Midnight Threaders earrings ($135). littlemountain.space

SPARKLE AND SHINE

Des Petits Hauts adds a little shimmer at the ankle with these sparkly ribbed socks ($55). lappartementvancouver.com

BEADY EYES

French brand Pylones fills this chunky blown-glass ring ($39) with bright beads. branchesandknots.com

WRIST WATCH

B.C. brand Freshly Unbothered gives part of its profits from cheekily named gemstone bracelets (from $27) to charity, though it makes no promises about magic powers. freshlyunbothered.com

WHO WEARS SHORT SHORTS?

Midweight and cut short, the Terry Fadeaway sweatshorts ($118) are likely to become a fixture in his wardrobe. reigningchamp.com

SLIP INTO SOMETHING

Cork-soled Asportuguesas slippers ($185) offer a relaxed, sustainable swap for an old pair of slides. gravitypope.com

HATS OFF

Fingerless Joe’s Dad caps ($50) carry embroidered nods to local spots like Save On Meats and Kingsgate Mall. wootoseeyou.com

FACE OFF

Artist and ceramicist Meg Hübert designed the playful characters on this Floating Face kids tee ($38). meghubert.com

READ MORE: Personal Space: Meg and Steve Hübert Hand-Painted the Tiles in Their Kitchen

LIGHT AS A FEATHER

Artist Lowen De Neve 3D-prints these featherweight nylon Royal Sunset earrings ($65). craftcouncilbc.shop

Gifts for the Home and Design Lovers

DOUBLE DUTY

The rechargeable Pedrali Filicudi lamp ($325) doubles as a sleek flower vase while it charges. bloomfs.com

MAKES SCENTS

For a less expected holiday scent than evergreen, Homecoming Candles offers Fir Needle and Pear ($35). homecomingcandles.com

HAPPY ENDINGS

Designed by Alain van Havre for Ethnicraft, the solid wood PI book ends ($259) are a fitting partner for a shelf of books. fullhousemodern.com

POTTED PERFECTION

Artist Francis Chan of Potluck Ceramics hand-makes each one-of-a-kind Pictograph vase ($200), a modern take on the Grecian urn. fullhousemodern.com

THINK PINK

Ferm Living’s blush Ripple lamp ($305) casts a gentle glow through ribbed glass. fullhousemodern.com

MELLOW YELLOW

Bocci’s 14p wireless light ($375) now comes in yellow, a bright spot for grey days. livingspace.com

TWIN FLAMES

Muuto’s new anodized aluminum Pair candle holders ($142) live up to the brand’s own description: playful yet refined. vanspecial.com

SQUISH LIST

The soft, quirky Good Beast Pebble vase now comes in tangerine (from $90, in matte or natural finish). goodbeast.ca

FACE THE TRUTH

What goes inside this Wrap Faces storage tin ($33) is entirely up to the recipient. thecoastgoods.ca

FULL OF BEANS

Muji’s Body Fit cushion ($280 for cushion plus cover) manages to make the beanbag chair look stylish. muji.ca

VEG OUT

These Happy Organics beeswax candles ($12 for a pair) are shaped like surprisingly realistic vegetables. cocomain.ca

SPACE CASE

Macon et Lesquoy’s hand-embroidered astronaut brooch ($74) makes a fun, space-themed present. walrushome.com

NEVER FORGET

Lineasette’s Italian stoneware elephant (from $129) works in a child’s room or as a decorative piece for adults. inspirationfurniture.ca

A LITTLE SALTY

Ohhelloleigh Ceramics’ Froggy salt cellar ($120) includes a spoon shaped like a tongue. ohhelloleigh.com

RAISE A GLASS

Glassmaker Holmegaard teamed with Danish brewer Mikkeller on these design-forward pint glasses ($54 per pair). vanspecial.com

TWIST AND SHOUT

The sculptural Flores Paper Spiral pad ($66) makes jotting everyday notes feel special. shopneighbour.com

SEE YOU SPOON

A tortoiseshell full cutlery set from Parisian brand Sabre ($124) gives dinner parties an upgrade. thecoastgoods.ca

↑ Back to Gift Categories

Beauty and Self-Care Gifts

GETTING STEAMY

Fern and Petal’s red cedar and eucalyptus shower steamers ($63) bring spa vibes to the bathroom. fernandpetal.com

SPRAY DAY

Indigenous-owned Sweetgrass Soap’s smudge spray ($32; sage, cedar and tobacco leaves) offers a flame-free way to cleanse a space. sweetgrasssoap.com

5 O’CLOCK SOMEWHERE

Henrik Vibskov’s Ambient Glare 5 O’Clock fragrance ($235) centres on bergamot, pink pepper and pine in a sculptural bottle. theblock.ca

GLOW ON

Vancouver brand Salty Face makes a coconut-scented Tanning Water ($46) for a summery glow without stained palms. saltyface.com

BRUSHING UP

A tube of lemon-coconut Before toothpaste ($12) makes a fun stocking stuffer, as long as nobody reads into it. gravitypope.com

NOT THE PITS

Nala’s locally made natural deodorant ($28), scented with sandalwood and bergamot, could be a welcome bit of luxury. hillsdrygoods.com

LAYER UP

A 100-percent European linen robe (from $98) from Wilet is the next best thing to staying wrapped in its linen sheets. shopwilet.com

MAGIC POTION

Main Street’s Sunja Link is known for effective products such as its antioxidant, peptide-packed C serum ($49). sunjalink.com

↑ Back to Gift Categories

Food, Drink and Kitchen Gifts

EGGCELLENCE

This rectangular copper pan from Kiya ($178) heats evenly for fluffy tamago, the Japanese rolled omelette. itsumo.ca

CHILL OUT

Georg Jensen’s stainless-steel freezable Sky ice cubes ($80) chill drinks with Danish design flair. inform.ca

BETTER, BETTER, BEST

In Obsessed with the Best ($53), Ella Quittner compares cooking techniques to find the best way to make each recipe. inform.ca

WHAT A DRIP

Single-serve Kndz drip bag coffees ($19 for seven servings) give coffee lovers a pour-over on the road, no Chemex required. vanspecial.ca

ISLAND TIME

Ollie and Co.’s Granville Island two-ounce travel candle ($15) captures market scents like tomato, celery and pepper. ollieandco.ca

MAGIC MATCHA

Vancouver ceramicist Kate Metten’s hand-thrown, spouted Reduction matcha whisk bowl ($90) is made for preparing matcha. katemetten.com

↑ Back to Gift Categories

Outdoor, Travel and Tech Gifts

PUFF STUFF

The MEC Hut booties ($90) act like slippers for campers, warming feet after a day in heavy boots. mec.ca

WATCH OUT

Nocs Provisions’ compact waterproof binoculars ($125) suit birders, hikers and the merely curious. mec.ca

ANOTHER ROUND?

Vancouver golf brand Dreich designs its stretchy waterproof Highland golf pant ($328) for playing through the rain. dreichgolf.com

TAKE COVER

An umbrella may be an obvious gift for a Vancouverite, but these two-tone Anatole Alice bumbershoots ($66) should see plenty of use. thecoastgoods.ca

NOW HEAR THIS

Audio-Technica’s ATH-CKS50TW2 noise-cancelling earbuds ($219) offer up to 65 hours of play with the case and earn praise from audiophiles. visions.ca

PITCH PERFECT

The Copenhagen-designed Bluetooth-connected Transparent speakers ($879) deliver audio to match their striking looks. vanspecial.com

NET GAINS

Two-tone Blue Lug cargo nets ($25) hold whatever is in a bike basket firmly in place. sortdays.com

PACK RAT

Canadian brand Monos offers a limited-edition terrazzo set ($115 for four) of compression packing cubes for frequent flyers. monos.com

THAT’S A PADDLIN’

A candy-coloured, carbon-frame Play One Round racket ($137) could be the push a friend needs to try pickleball. visitfairgrounds.com

MAKING IT

The 20th-anniversary edition Cricut Maker 5 ($449) is a powerful gift for crafters, who may return the favour with a custom card. michaels.com

LISTEN UP

The Head(amame) parts kit ($183) includes everything needed to 3D print and build lightweight custom headphones. headamame.com

WATER WORLD

The pared-back Kinto Work Out bottle ($35) is tipped as this season’s must-have water bottle. welks.ca

↑ Back to Gift Categories

Gifts for Kids, Pets and Playful People

SPLISH SPLASH

Loot Toy Co.’s Bubble Whoosh bubble bath ($20) makes aquamarine foam with a tropical scent from natural, hypoallergenic ingredients. hipbaby.com

BRUSHING UP

This tiny pocket watercolour set ($32) uses fine Italian pigments and slips into a young artist’s pocket. collagecollage.ca

STICKY SITUATION

Hissing Mink’s stickers (from $5.50), including a cryptid design, celebrate the quirky side of the West Coast. banyen.com

BEARLY THERE

This bucket hat ($85) doubles as Bartholomew, a Jellycat bear, and could be a holiday hit with a young niece. holtrenfrew.com

CUT UPS

Urban Source fills pizza boxes for its Collage Party kits ($65) with two pairs of scissors, glue and curated paper scraps. urbansource.ca

PLAY DATE

This wooden Lillabo play garage from Ikea ($40) keeps toy time in step with a pared-back Scandinavian living room. ikea.com

SNAP TO IT

Matching Things ($18) puts a spin on Snap and comes from the creators of the picture book Invisible Things. kidsbooks.ca

FUR BABIES

Furei’s waterproof Moodies collars ($20) have extra holes for screw-in enamel pins ($4 each) shaped like hot dogs, boots or bows. shopgoodboy.com
